640-3220-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
640-3220-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2829-3263-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
2829-3263-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Repeat from step 3.
2829-3263-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

465-4681-6495.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
465-4681-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2757-3525-7938.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Shuttle Ace.
Shuttle Ace triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Shuttle Ace
Repeat.

1090-1895-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

341-1621-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1251-2590-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

1368-4359-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4359-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

5295-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5295-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5295-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7640.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reputable Merchant.
When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3277-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

891-997-7424.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2149-2440-3019.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Zaffai
1618-2149-2440-3019.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Zaffai triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
1618-2149-2440-3019.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Zaffai. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

2034-4215-6005.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken green creature.
2034-4215-6005.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken green creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the green creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-4556-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2292-4556-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Blight Mound and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2308-4050-4716-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4050-4716-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4359-4365.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

232-1235-2187-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

57-283-969-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-969-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

7-1069-7070.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
7-1069-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The equip ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0}
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

413-3773-6972--112.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Cultivator of Blades ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-3773-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

869-1987-4045-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

372-2781-3742.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-2781-3742.notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian exiled by Phantom Steed
372-2781-3742.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Phantom Steed and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Felidar Guardian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Phantom Steed to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Phantom Steed and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Phantom Steed and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-4276-4863-5913.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-4276-4863-5913.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and Revolutionist.
When Pinnacle Monk and Revolutionist enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4276-4863-5913.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

764-1994-2021-4802.easyPrerequisites: Eldrazi Conscription attached to Master Biomancer.
764-1994-2021-4802.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause another creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Colossus Hammer attached to Master Biomancer.
764-1994-2021-4802.description:
Cause another creature to enter the battlefield under your control with at least 22 +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, putting 22 growth counters on Simic Ascendancy.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's third ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

985-4487-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Marauder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.
